facts.business: Nicco Parks & Resorts Limited operates an amusement park and provides food & beverage and other recreational facilities in Kolkata, West Bengal.

auditor.name: Messers Lodha & Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to repossession of land by Department of Tourism, Government of West Bengal on 08-Nov-2025 used for F&B and Other Recreational Facilities segment; operations continued on behalf of WBTDCL pending formal agreement. Material uncertainty related to going concern due to pending lease renewal and formalization of arrangements.

key_risks: Repossession of land by Government of West Bengal affecting F&B and Other Recreational Facilities segment
Pending lease renewal and formalization of operational arrangements with WBTDCL
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to unresolved lease and operational agreements
Provision for incremental lease rentals based on management estimates pending final agreement
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited (WBTDCL) regarding management of repossessed F&B and recreational facilities; payable to WBTDCL of Rs 341.04 lakhs as at 31st March 2026.
